purpose: Expose Docling document conversion to the agent as MCP tools, in remote mode against the shared Docling Serve instance
public_interfaces: MCP over HTTP on container port 8000
invariants: Runs in remote conversion mode against the same Docling Serve instance the ingestion path uses, with a compatible timeout and retry budget. Two Docling paths that disagree about the endpoint would give the agent and the ingestion pipeline different answers about the same document
Local fallback conversion stays disabled: a silent fallback would move GPU work into a sidecar sized for none
Reachable only on the service-egress network and only under the mcp Compose profile
